plugins.name: sumi
plugins.description: UX/UI design mastery plugin — 22 skills, 22 commands across 6 numbered phases (GROUND → DISCOVER → DIAGNOSE → FORTIFY → BUILD → LAUNCH). Phase.step addresses (0.1–5.3) grounded in NNG design thinking and visual design process. Phase Position headers, sequential Next Steps, dual UX + commercial milestones. NNG process workflow, heuristics, cognitive psychology, production code (React/SwiftUI/CSS), Figma MCP, WCAG 2.2+3.0, mobile/desktop/web, AI/spatial/voice UX.
